title: The Sound of Syntax: Finetuning and Comprehensive Evaluation of Language Models for Speech Pathology

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance on diagnostic classification tasks across 1,000 utterances for each gender, using demographic identifiers from the UltraSuite dataset metadata.

Analyzing model classification and transcription performance across three specific age brackets (early-elementary: 5-7 years, mid-elementary: 8-10 years, and post-elementary: 10+ years) using structured age data from the UltraSuite dataset.

Assessing Word Error Rate (WER) and disorder diagnosis accuracy across different languages (English, French, Dutch) as well as evaluating model generalization on low-resource tonal languages (Taiwanese, Cantonese).
